title: Encrypt with AES-GCM
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Encrypt with AES-GCM.
learning_objectives: Explain encrypt with aes-gcm using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for encrypt with aes-gcm
Assess failure and operational limits of encrypt with aes-gcm
concepts_covered: Authenticated encryption produces ciphertext and a tag; changing ciphertext or tag should cause decryption to fail.
encrypt uses AES-256-GCM with a random 12-byte IV and returns IV/ciphertext/tag as Base64.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
